Thanks again for the interest — great to meet you at the briefing last week. Would love to get a 45-minute demo on the calendar to walk the SRE and payments teams through Redwood’s latency controls and dedicated capacity options.

- Wed 10 Nov, 10:00–10:45
- Thu 11 Nov, 14:00–14:45
- Fri 12 Nov, 11:00–11:45

If none of those work, send a couple of slots that do and we’ll adapt. I attached a short pre-demo logistics doc so your team knows what to expect and who to invite.

Hi Irene — thanks for the slots. Unfortunately we have a company-wide Global Ops Summit and a mandatory on-call blackout for our SREs from Nov 9–13, so the dates you suggested overlap with internal duties. Also, our SRE lead (Priya) is at RSA through Nov 7 and won't be back until the 8th.

Can we look at the week of Nov 29 / Dec 1 or early December? Ideally we want the SRE and Payments engineering leads present.

We’d also like an optional asynchronous option (recording) for folks who are still traveling.

Thanks — Samir
Samir Khan | Head of Payments Engineering
QuantaPay

Folks — forwarding Samir’s note. QuantaPay needs to push out due to their Ops Summit + RSA travel. Two quick asks: (1) confirm our availability for the Tue/Wed after Thanksgiving (Nov 29–30) and (2) should we offer an "asynchronous demo" option (recorded + short Q&A) to keep momentum?

Context / constraints:
- We have a company maintenance blackout Nov 22–26 but are clear the week after.
- Marcus: can you confirm capacity for a dedicated-demo slot (we typically reserve a 60-min slot for SRE-heavy deep dives)?
- Monica: do you want to run the async recording + one-hour live Q&A? We can send them a lightweight intake form beforehand (I included a draft availability matrix).

Proposed reply: offer Nov 29 10:00–11:00 PST or Nov 30 13:00–14:00 PST, or we provide a 25-min recorded walkthrough + 30-min live Q&A on a date they choose.

Irene

I’ve also attached a calendar invite stub and an availability matrix in case you need to shift. - Samir Khan — Head of Payments Engineering (QuantaPay)
- Priya Natarajan — SRE Lead (QuantaPay)
- Irene Choi — Senior AE (Redwood)
- Marcus Lin — Solutions Engineer (Redwood)
- Monica Patel — Customer Success (Redwood)

Next steps:
1) Confirm Nov 29, 10:00–11:00 PST (I’ll send a calendar invite)
2) If you prefer the recorded + Q&A option, let me know and we’ll dispatch the recording within 24 hours and schedule the Q&A for a time that suits your team.
